name: project-workflow
description: Initialize repository guidance, maintain project documentation, and turn accepted decisions into executable goals.

interface.shortDescription: Repository knowledge, docs, and consensus goals
interface.longDescription: Build a scoped AGENTS.md hierarchy, standardize evidence-backed project documentation, and turn accepted discussion decisions into drafted or persistent goals.
defaultPrompt: 使用 $project-workflow:init-deep 初始化或更新当前仓库的 AGENTS.md 层级。
使用 $project-workflow:write-project-docs 维护当前项目的中文核心文档。
使用 $project-workflow:start-consensus-goal 将当前共识整理成 GOAL 并启动。
